tools.name: search_brands
tools.description: Find brands in the WikiBrand catalogue by name or domain, optionally within a category. Returns each brand's domain, name, category and signature color.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: A brand's identity as its own website shows it: logo (SVG or image URL, with the ground it sits on), colors (signature, page, ink, palette), typefaces, tone of voice, and its full theme as CSS custom properties. Works for any website: one nobody has read yet is read on the spot (about a minute). Use
